[SWS_DM_00121] Forbidden clearing of snapshot records and ex- tended data records
⌈
If the DM is requested to clear a DTC with a forbidden clear
according to [SWS_DM_00896] the DM shall leave all snapshot records and ex-
tended data records for this DTC unchanged.
⌋
